about.title: Professional Profile
about.description: Frontend developer from Morocco specializing in modern web application development with React and Next.js. I combine clean code practices with creative problem-solving to deliver fast, accessible, and maintainable products.

experiences.description: Managed and maintained internal IT systems and network infrastructure to ensure stability and availability. Provided first and second-level technical support, resolving critical hardware, software, and network issues rapidly to minimize operational downtime. Streamlined support processes through documentation, reducing average resolution time.

Designed, developed, and launched 6+ custom, performance-focused websites using Next.js and React. Implemented responsive, high-fidelity UIs with Tailwind CSS. Applied rigorous technical standards to deliver maintainable, scalable, and high-quality codebases while providing technical consulting to clients.

Built a comprehensive e-commerce management dashboard using React.js. Streamlined the UI with Tailwind CSS & Bootstrap, cutting page load times by 40%. Secured API communications via Axios with JWT authentication and designed data visualizations using ECharts.

Developed a web application to automate the management of association and cooperative files using a React.js frontend and Node.js backend. Digitized the entire file process, improving administrative efficiency and implementing data filtering and authorization features.
